goal.text: Asher's stated goal is for the company to run 90-95% autonomously.

figure.intro: These measures follow approved work through acceptance and release, and show where agent time goes. They are not a company autonomy rate: the founder's time is not yet measured.

metrics.label: Outcomes accepted October 13–16 that were released to their destination within 72 hours
metrics.blurb: Reached its destination (merged, deployed or sent) within 72 hours of acceptance. Since October 13.
metrics.method: review accept events 2026-10-13T21:00Z to 72 h before 2026-10-20T16:00Z, paired with a recorded release within 72 h.

metrics.label: Outcomes approved since October 13 (at least three days ago) that the founder has accepted
metrics.blurb: Approved since October 13 and accepted since. The last three days are excluded.
metrics.method: outcome_approved events 2026-10-13T21:00Z to 72 h before 2026-10-20T16:00Z; accepted = a review accept event for the same outcome.

metrics.label: Agent working minutes on client and product projects since October 13
metrics.shortLabel: Agent time on clients and products
metrics.blurb: Share of agent working time spent on client work and products. Since October 13.
metrics.method: Owner-session minutes clipped to 2026-10-13T21:00Z – 2026-10-20T16:00Z; internal = the runtime and the Lab site.
